completion.storage: one registered response per direction; metadata head retained until normal/rejected response is consumed
completion.order: direction-local acceptance order, except fault events are diagnostics not successful retirements
completion.transport_fault: reported without waiting for adapter_done; response acceptance does not retire faulted head
completion.descriptor_error: not issued to DataMover; retired in order when scheduler accepts response

configuration.required: override tables to match actual bank wrappers and adapter word widths

scheduler_abort: pulse latched per channel until common reset; forwarded to active adapter, never generated by engine status decoding
pause: prevents new scheduler acceptance only; does not retract already accepted/staged DataMover commands
reset: scheduler/board controller must reset DataMover, engine and adapters coherently; engine-only fault reset is unsafe

memory_banks.latency_parameter: one shared BANK_READ_LAT value for every bank-pool consumer
memory_banks.reset_scope: read-output pipeline only; memory contents retained

verification_limit: behavioral command controller tests, adapter regressions, engine lint, and 4 XSIM scheduler-BFM/engine/adapter/arbiter integration configurations with modeled DDR/DataMover/banks; no vendor DataMover/XPM/board signoff
